title: Final velocity of A
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for v₁, either as ((m+M)v₀ - Mv)/m or an algebraically equivalent form.

title: Final thrust force magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the thrust force, either as M(v - v₀)/Δt or an algebraically equivalent form.

title: Apply momentum conservation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the law of conservation of linear momentum to the separation event.

title: Use impulse-momentum theorem
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply the impulse-momentum theorem (FΔt = Δp) to composite B to find the thrust force.

title: Correct system definition
description: Important Criteria: The momentum conservation step must correctly identify the initial system (A+B together) and the final separate systems.

title: Sign error in force expression
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the force expression has the incorrect sign, e.g., M(v₀ - v)/Δt, showing confusion about the direction of the thrust.

title: Algebraic manipulation errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points for significant algebraic errors in solving the momentum equation for v₁.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may verify that the derived expressions have the correct units for velocity (m/s) and force (N).
